name: VMware ESXi / vCenter
author: Netlens
description: Shows VMware ESXi hosts and vCenter inventories: every host (connection state, management address) and every virtual machine as a guest of its host, with power state, MAC and IP addresses (from VMware Tools), guest operating system, CPUs and memory. Works with a standalone ESXi and with vCenter through VMware's SOAP web service, read-only: it only reads properties. Use an account with the Read-only role.

info.title: A read-only account
info.text: Create a user (in ESXi: Host > Manage > Security & users, or in vCenter: Administration > Users) and give it the built-in 'Read-only' role on the root of the inventory. Netlens never changes anything. IP addresses and MAC addresses of guests come from VMware Tools; without Tools only the MAC addresses of the virtual network cards are known.

config.label: ESXi hosts and vCenters
config.help: One line per ESXi or vCenter. For a vCenter list the vCenter only: it already knows all hosts.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: ESXi and vCenter use a self-signed certificate until you install your own.
